en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding the injuries in the fingers when the bones are exposed, is a tenth of the wergild of the finger, when the injured one does not intend that he retaliates’.
